---
title: "Transition from suicidal ideation to first suicide attempt: main analysis"
output: html_document
---

This script contains the main regression analyses and multiple-testing corrections.
It assumes that the cleaned, multiply imputed follow-up dataset and factor-level
objects are already available. 
Data preparation, local file paths and spreadsheet/table exports are excluded.
The original model specifications and statistical calculations are retained.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## 1. Packages and required inputs

```{r packages-and-inputs}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(survey)
})
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

required_objects <- c("data_fu", "m_imp", "lev_country", "lev_month", "lev_strata")
missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(required_objects, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_objects)) {
  stop("Load the prepared analysis inputs first: ", paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "))
}
```

## 2. Define predictors and model formulas

Code object names retain their original numbering. Manuscript Models 1, 2 and 3 correspond to `m3`, `biv_results[["md_cat"]]` and `m5_num`, respectively. Additional candidate models are retained for the original model comparisons.

## 3. Fit a survey-weighted model within one imputation

Models use a quasipoisson family with a log link, follow-up weights, university/school clusters (`strata`) and country strata. Warnings and failed fits are recorded.

```{r fit-one-imputation}
fit_one_imp <- function(dat, formula, imp_id){

  warn_msgs <- character(0)

  des <- svydesign(
    ids = ~strata,
    strata = ~country,
    weights = ~followup1_norm_weight,
    data = dat,
    nest = TRUE
  )

  mod <- tryCatch(

    withCallingHandlers(
      svyglm(
        formula = formula,
        design = des,
        family = quasipoisson(link = "log")
      ),

      warning = function(w){
        warn_msgs <<- c(warn_msgs, conditionMessage(w))
      }
    ),

    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(mod, "error")){
    log_entry <- data.frame(
      imputation = imp_id,
      failed = TRUE,
      n_warnings = length(warn_msgs) + 1,
      messages = paste(c(conditionMessage(mod), warn_msgs), collapse = " | "),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    return(list(
      betas = NULL,
      vcov_mod = NULL,
      model = NULL,
      log = log_entry
    ))
  }

  log_entry <- data.frame(
    imputation = imp_id,
    failed = FALSE,
    n_warnings = length(warn_msgs),
    messages = paste(warn_msgs, collapse = " | "),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  list(
    betas = coef(mod),
    vcov_mod = as.matrix(vcov(mod)),
    model = mod,
    log  = log_entry
  )

}
```

## 4. Pool estimates using Rubin's rules

The original pooling implementation is retained, including Rubin's original degrees-of-freedom formula. Raw pooled p-values retain full precision for BH correction. Risk ratios and ordinary 95% confidence intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted.

```{r pool-estimates}
pool_rubin_rr <- function(fits){
  m <- length(fits)

  pnames <- names(fits[[1]]$betas)

  align_one <- function(f){
    b <- f$betas
    v <- f$vcov_mod

    if (!all(pnames %in% names(b))){
      missing <- setdiff(pnames, names(b))
      stop("Missing coefficients in an imputation: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
    }

    if (!all(pnames %in% rownames(v)) || !all(pnames %in% colnames(v))) {
      stop("vcv mismatch across imputations. check factor levels.")
    }

    list(
      b = b[pnames],
      v = v[pnames, pnames, drop = FALSE]
    )
  }

  aligned <- lapply(fits, align_one)

  B_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(aligned, `[[`, "b" ))

  Q_bar <- colMeans(B_mat)

  U_bar <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(aligned, `[[`, "v"))/ m

  B <- stats::cov(B_mat)

  T_total <- U_bar + (1 + 1/m) * B

  Udiag <- diag(U_bar)

  Bdiag <- diag(B)

  riv <- (1 + 1 /m) * (Bdiag / Udiag)

  riv[!is.finite(riv)] <- 0

  df_old <- (m-1) * (1 + 1 / riv)^2

  df_old[!is.finite(df_old)] <- 1e6

  fmi <- riv / (1 + riv)

  se_pooled <- sqrt(diag(T_total))

  t_stat <- Q_bar / se_pooled

  p_value <- 2 * stats::pt(-abs(t_stat), df = df_old)

  results <- data.frame(
    Predictor = pnames,
    beta      = round(Q_bar, 4),
    RR        = round(exp(Q_bar), 3),
    CI_low    = round(exp(Q_bar - stats::qt(0.975, df = df_old) * se_pooled), 3),
    CI_high   = round(exp(Q_bar + stats::qt(0.975, df = df_old) * se_pooled), 3),
    SE_pooled = round(se_pooled, 4),
    df_old    = round(df_old, 1),
    p         = p_value,
    riv       = round(riv, 3),
    fmi       = round(fmi, 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(results) <- NULL

  list(
    results = results,
    Q_bar = Q_bar,
    T_total = T_total,
    U_bar = U_bar,
    B = B,
    df_old = df_old,
    riv = riv,
    fmi = fmi
  )
}
```

## 5. Run each model across imputations

Eligibility is evaluated within each completed imputation. Coefficients common to all imputations are pooled; dropped coefficients, warnings and failures are logged.

```{r run-imputations}
run_all_imps <- function(data_all, formula, filter_quos, label){
  cat("\n================================\n")
  cat(" ", label, "\n")
  cat("==================================\n")

    fits <- vector("list", m_imp)
    fit_logs <- vector("list", m_imp)

    for (i in 1:m_imp){
     cat(" Imputation", i, "...")

     dat_i <- data_all %>%
      filter(`_IMPUTATION_` == i) %>%
      filter(!!!filter_quos) %>%
      mutate(
        country = factor(country, levels = lev_country),
        f_month12 = factor(f_month12, levels = lev_month),
        strata = factor(strata, levels = lev_strata)
      )

    if (i == 1) cat( "N =", nrow(dat_i), "...")

    fits[[i]] <- fit_one_imp(dat_i, formula, imp_id = i )

    fit_logs[[i]] <- fits[[i]]$log
    cat("done\n")
    }
    log_df <- bind_rows(fit_logs)

  failed_fit <- vapply(fits, function(x) is.null(x$model), logical(1))
  if (any(failed_fit)){
    cat("\nFailed imputations detected:\n")
    print(log_df %>% filter(failed), row.names = FALSE)
    stop("At least one imputation failed completely.")
  }

  n_warn <- sum(log_df$n_warnings > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("\nwarnings in", n_warn, "of", m_imp, "imputations. \n")
  if(n_warn >0){
    print(log_df %>% filter(n_warnings > 0), row.names= FALSE)
  }

  common_coefs <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(fits, function(x) names(x$betas)))

  dropped <- setdiff(names(fits[[1]]$betas), common_coefs)
  log_df$dropped_coefs <- paste(dropped, collapse = ", ")
  log_df$n_dropped <- length(dropped)
  if (length(dropped) > 0)
    cat("\nDropped from pooling for", dropped, "\n")

  fits_aligned <- lapply(fits, function(f){
    f$betas <- f$betas[common_coefs]
    f$vcov_mod <- f$vcov_mod[common_coefs, common_coefs, drop = FALSE]
    f
  })

  finite_coef <- vapply(fits_aligned, function(x) all(is.finite(x$betas)), logical(1))
  finite_vcov <- vapply(fits_aligned, function(x) all(is.finite(x$vcov_mod)), logical(1))

  if(!all(finite_coef)) stop("non-finite beta detected")
  if(!all(finite_vcov)) stop("non-finite VCV entries detected")

  pooled <- pool_rubin_rr(fits_aligned)

  cat("\nPooled results (df_old):\n")
  print(pooled$results %>%
          filter(!Predictor %in% c("(Intercept)") &
                 !startsWith(Predictor, "country")),
        row.names = FALSE)

  list(
     results = pooled$results %>%
          filter(!Predictor %in% c("(Intercept)") &
                 !startsWith(Predictor, "country")),
     pooled = pooled,
     fits = fits,
     log = log_df
  )

}
```

## 6. Fit the fixed and candidate models

The risk set comprises follow-up participants with lifetime ideation and no lifetime attempt at baseline. The outcome is a 12-month suicide attempt at follow-up. Counts may vary across imputations.

```{r fit-fixed-models}
filter_main <- quos(T0_LT_suic_idea == 1, T0_LT_suic_attempt == 0)

m1 <- run_all_imps(data_fu, fml_m1, filter_main, "MODEL 1 - Sociodemographic")
m3 <- run_all_imps(data_fu, fml_m3, filter_main, "MODEL 3 - STB cluster")
m4 <- run_all_imps(data_fu, fml_m4, filter_main, "MODEL 4 - MDs")
m5 <- run_all_imps(data_fu, fml_m5, filter_main, "MODEL 5 - Full")

m5_type <- run_all_imps(data_fu, fml_s4_type, filter_main, "MODEL 5 - Type only")
m5_num  <- run_all_imps(data_fu, fml_s4_num,  filter_main, "MODEL 5 - Number only")
```

## 7. Fit adjusted bivariable models and apply BH correction

The four sociodemographic coefficients come from their joint model. Each disorder or STB characteristic is then tested in a separate model adjusted for all four sociodemographics, COVID-19 period, assessment timing and country. Disorder count is fitted as a categorical predictor. Four separate BH families contain 23, 12, 7 and 15 tests; see the README for their definitions.

```{r bivariable-and-bh}
rhs_controls <- "Year_cat_dicho + f_month12 + country + female + lgbtq + f_ParEdu_college + T0_Age_z"

stb_vars <- c(
  "LT_suic_idea_aoo_z", "T0_LT_suic_idea_y_z", "T0_Ideat_NumDayWrst_z",
  "T0_Ideat_LongLast_z", "ideation_control_z", "ideation_risk_z",
  "T0_suic_ideat_12m_m_z", "T0_suic_plan_12M"
)

bh_vars <- c(md_vars, stb_vars)

biv_results <- list()

biv_results[["md_cat"]] <- run_all_imps(
  data_fu,
  as.formula(paste("T1_suic_attempt_12M ~", rhs_controls, "+ md_cat")),
  filter_main, "MODEL 2 - md_cat"
)

for (v in bh_vars) {
  biv_results[[v]] <- run_all_imps(
    data_fu,
    as.formula(paste("T1_suic_attempt_12M ~", rhs_controls, "+", v)),
    filter_main, paste("MODEL 2 -", v)
  )
}

get_bh_rows <- function(results, predictors) {
  map_dfr(predictors, function(v) {
    hit <- results %>%
      filter(Predictor == v | Predictor == paste0(v, "1")) %>%
      select(Predictor, RR, CI_low, CI_high, p)

    if (nrow(hit) != 1L || any(!is.finite(hit$p)) ||
        any(hit$p < 0 | hit$p > 1)) {
      stop("Expected one valid pooled p-value for: ", v)
    }

    hit %>% mutate(Variable = v, .before = 1)
  })
}

soc_vars <- c("T0_Age_z", "f_ParEdu_college", "lgbtq", "female")
md_count_coefs <- c("md_cat1", "md_cat2", "md_cat3+")

bh_biv_soc <- get_bh_rows(m1$results, soc_vars) %>%
  mutate(Source = "sociodemographic")

bh_biv_individual <- map_dfr(bh_vars, function(v) {
  get_bh_rows(biv_results[[v]]$results, v) %>%
    mutate(Source = v)
})

bh_biv_count <- get_bh_rows(
  biv_results[["md_cat"]]$results, md_count_coefs
) %>%
  mutate(Source = "md_cat")

bh_bivariate <- bind_rows(bh_biv_soc, bh_biv_individual, bh_biv_count)
stopifnot(
  nrow(bh_bivariate) == 23L,
  !anyDuplicated(bh_bivariate$Predictor),
  all(is.finite(bh_bivariate$p))
)
bh_bivariate <- bh_bivariate %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

adjust_model_bh <- function(results, predictors, expected_n) {
  out <- get_bh_rows(results, predictors)
  stopifnot(
    nrow(out) == expected_n,
    !anyDuplicated(out$Predictor),
    all(is.finite(out$p))
  )
  out %>% mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
}

bh_multivariable_1 <- adjust_model_bh(
  m3$results, c(soc_vars, stb_vars), 12L
)

bh_multivariable_2 <- adjust_model_bh(
  biv_results[["md_cat"]]$results, c(soc_vars, md_count_coefs), 7L
)

bh_multivariable_3 <- adjust_model_bh(
  m5_num$results, c(soc_vars, stb_vars, md_count_coefs), 15L
)

attach_bh <- function(results, bh_table) {
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(bh_table$Predictor))
  results %>%
    select(-any_of("p_adj")) %>%
    left_join(bh_table %>% select(Predictor, p_adj), by = "Predictor")
}

model2_bh_results <- attach_bh(
  biv_results[["md_cat"]]$results, bh_multivariable_2
)
soc_biv_bh_results <- attach_bh(
  m1$results, bh_bivariate %>% filter(Source == "sociodemographic")
)
for (v in names(biv_results)) {
  biv_results[[v]]$results <- attach_bh(
    biv_results[[v]]$results,
    bh_bivariate %>% filter(Source == v)
  )
}
```

## Results

Results remain in the R session. The objects below contain the focal coefficients,
ordinary confidence intervals, raw p-values and BH-adjusted p-values for the four
manuscript analysis families. No files are written by this script.

```{r inspect-bh-results}
bh_bivariate
bh_multivariable_1
bh_multivariable_2
bh_multivariable_3
```
